ANU HDR Fee Merit Scholarship
ᐱ
ON THE PAGE
About this scholarship
Each year the Australian National University offers the ANU HDR Fee Merit Scholarship (concurrently with the ANU University Research Scholarship) to support high achieving international HDR students who are conducting research which aligns with the strategic directions of the University.
Field of study
All
Duration
Payments made for 4 years for PhD and 2 years for MPhil
Eligibility
Scholarship type
Academic
Student type
International
Study level
Postgraduate research (HDR)
Selection bases
Academic merit
The award will be available each year to a prospective or continuing student who:
is an international student enrolling in an accredited HDR course of study at the University; and
has also been awarded an ANU University Research Scholarship; and
has achieved a minimum of Honours 1 (H1) or H1 equivalent in their prior studies.
Ongoing eligibility
Continuation based on maintaining base stipend scholarships
How to apply
No application is required specifically for this scholarship as all eligible candidates will be considered based upon their application for admission
Key scholarship details
Application period

Application period is open all year round.

Further information
The scholarship includes:
International Student Fees (ISF) for program duration (4 years PhD, 2 years MPhil).
Overseas Health Cover (OSHC) for scholar and immediate family.
No application is required specifically for this scholarship as all eligible candidates will be considered based upon their application for admission

In order to be considered for this scholarship in the main round of scholarship offers International students are required to apply for admission by either 15 April or 31 August.
Applicants are also strongly encouraged to make contact with the relevant Graduate Studies Convener or a prospective supervisor, prior to lodging an application, to discuss the proposed research topic and related matters.
